title: Kubescape (CNCF, Apache-2.0): NSA/CISA and MITRE framework controls, from the JSON report the customer's pipeline writes
readScopes: None for the collector: it reads the report file. Kubescape runs in the customer's pipeline (`kubescape scan framework nsa,mitre --format json --output <file>`), against a cluster with a read-only kubeconfig (get, list, watch) or over manifests and Helm charts.

checks.title: C-0002: Prevent containers from allowing command execution
checks.scope: Kubescape control C-0002 (mitre and nsa framework, regolibrary 2.0.38): one result per scanned cluster or manifest set, counting the resources it applies to; who may exec into containers is an RBAC grant.
